notice: LIVE: sanitized evidence captured from the Qloo hackathon API. Values are query-relative and comparable only within one call (same correlationId).
limitations: Affinity and response popularity have no documented scale or direction; compare only within one correlationId.
compare_audiences, audience_demographics and trends fields are undocumented beyond demographics direction; kept opaque.
Target profile is derived (recurring tags across pinned exemplars), not a Qloo object.
Live values can change between captures; regression checks assert structure, not exact floats.

target = tags recurring in ≥2 of 10 pinned exemplars of urn:tag:interests:qloo:boutique_hospitality; not a Qloo profile
exemplars came from a Qloo query (pinned tag ∩ hotel category, popularity ≥ 0.95) and were then human-reviewed
each candidate territory is represented by one brand exemplar; see config approximations
tags in operational namespaces (credit_card, cost_description, specialty_dish, hotel_rating, inclusivity, amenity, offerings, service_option) are kept but are not taste signals
Qloo exposes no graph distance, path or hop count
Ceramics: Astier de Villatte exists in Qloo only as urn:entity:place stores, not as a brand.
Sailing / marine lifestyle: North Sails and Henri Lloyd exist only as place stores; Musto was not found. Helly Hansen (sailing heritage, outdoor) and Sebago (nautical footwear) are weak proxies.
Wellness: Six Senses is also a hospitality brand, so it does not separate wellness from hospitality.
